default.description: The webview's baseline grant. `core:default` is what makes `listen()` work at all — without it the event plugin's commands are denied, every listener registration rejects silently, and a turn runs to completion with nothing on screen. The four window grants exist because the app draws its own title bar (`decorations: false`): `core:window:default` is read-only, so without them the bar cannot be dragged and the window cannot be minimized, maximized or closed.
